name: Daybreak Trackbed
description: Lift the great bolt onto the shoulder with a qi-lightened back and carry it to the groove at a trot.

name: Charter Bowarms
description: Seat both pawls over the great string so the engine holds its wound state without a hand on the lever.

name: Sustaining Bolthead
description: Lay a palm on the skein after a long day's shooting to feel where the sinew has overheated.

name: Clear Springarm
description: Roll the great shaft on a flat plank and watch for the wobble that would spoil a long flight.

name: Streaktorment
description: Haul the great string to its last notch with qi in the arms and let the heavy shaft fly flat.

name: Glint Skewerbolt
description: Drive the great bolt through a rank of locked shields so that it splits the first and pins the second.

name: Raging Sinewcord
description: Send the great bolt with arms charged to the limit through a timber palisade, leaving a gap men can pass.

name: Cleaving Boltflight
description: Hold the loaded engine at full wind while qi gathers in the arms, then loose at one charging horse and rider.

name: Windlassdrum Elixir
description: Set each engine a fixed stride from the next, so that no shot crosses a neighbour's crew.

name: Remnant Aimframe
description: Follow the beat of one drum for wind, load and loose so a dozen engines move as one.

name: Renewing Aimframe
description: Pass a spare bolt hand to hand along the line to a crew whose rack has run dry.

name: Verity Windlassdrum
description: Keep the sight on the mark through a drifting dust cloud, steadied by a thread of qi in the eyes.

name: Granite Impalement
description: Loose the engines one after another along the line, so the bolts fall in a rolling wave across the target ground.

name: Splitting Stakedrive
description: Aim two neighbouring engines at one mark from different angles so the bolts converge and the target has no flank.

name: Racing Sinewcord
description: Slide a whole engine sideways by a carriage-width to fill the gap where a neighbour has fallen.

name: Shadeslider
description: Drive every engine of the line to loose at once on a single call, hammering one point of the enemy front.

name: Lot Trackbed
description: Gather the line at full wind on one signal, then loose a single concerted volley in answer to a charge.

name: Might Bolthead
description: Slow the breath to one in ten heartbeats, calming the chest before a mark too far to see clearly.

name: Vigorous Stockbed
description: Draw qi to the eyes until a far target grows crisp and the glare of the field fades.

name: Waning Bowarms
description: Test skein tension in the cool of morning and again at noon, marking how far the heat has softened it.

name: Fortifying Springarm
description: Walk the front pin along the rear sight's notches to the last one marked for extreme range.

name: Might Aimframe
description: Rest both forearms on the stock rail with qi steadying the wrists until the tremor leaves them.

name: Staketorment
description: Raise the nose to the last elevation mark and release so that the bolt falls from a great height.

name: Glintclaw
description: Loose at a distant rider's path rather than at the rider, so that horse and man meet the bolt together.

name: Anointing Trackbed
description: Watch the grass bend across the whole field and adjust the aim a fraction at a time before releasing.

name: Ironhurtle
description: Charge the bolt's head with qi through the string and send it at the far mark with little fall.

name: Streakassault
description: Hold the engine at full wind and the breath in the lungs through a long gathering, then loose one flawless bolt.

name: Hoarfrost Stockbed
description: Chop footholds into sloping ground behind each wheel so the engine does not creep during the shot.

name: Windlassdrum Remedy
description: Rub resin along the string's length to keep it supple and hold the knots against the long draw.

name: Daybreak Springarm
description: Space the hands along the winch bar by a fixed span so the long draw never binds.

name: Restoring Sinewcord
description: Slide a finger along the extended rail to feel for splinters before the long bolt rides it.

name: Equipoise Bolthead
description: Wind to half draw, pause for a breath of qi to settle the skein, and then wind to full.

name: Hurtletorment
description: Raise the nose steeply and loose so that the long bolt drops from above on a camp beyond a ridge.

name: Needling Skewerbolt
description: Set the stock at its farthest mark and throw the bolt to the very edge of the engine's reach.

name: Rumblestake
description: Gather qi into the wound arms until they hum, then release so the bolt arrives at full reach still driving deep.

name: Verity Bowarms
description: Two aimers breathe in time at the twin stocks, each hearing the other's rhythm before the shot.

name: Sinewcord Linctus
description: Set both stocks on the basin rim at the same elevation, matching them with a shared plumb.

name: Equipoise Trackbed
description: Two winders turn the paired winches together on one count so both strings rise at an even rate.

name: Granite Windlassdrum
description: Set the carriage wheels on the firm line above the river bank, where mud will not take them.

name: Gustslider
description: Loose the paired engines in the same instant so their bolts cross in front of the mark.

name: Tearing Impalement
description: Alternate the two engines in a steady beat so that one is always loosing while the other is wound.

name: Rumbleclaw
description: Raise the pair high then bring both noses down together, the bolts diving onto the mark like stooping hawks.

name: Successive Intent Stockbed
description: Loose the first engine along the flat track and the second along the high track in one breath.

name: Granite Boltflight
description: Aim both engines across the basin at one gap, gather at full wind, and loose together to seal it.

name: Waning Aimframe
description: Let qi gather behind the eyes until the whole field is read at once, as a hawk reads a basin.

name: Stockbed Remedy
description: Bring the near pin and the far pin into one line with the mark, then check the match.

name: Remnant Springarm
description: Tilt the helmet brim against the pale glare of the sky so the sight picture stays clean.

name: Daybreak Bowarms
description: Wipe both sight pins at the wrist with a clean cloth so dew or dust does not blur them.

name: Rousing Bolthead
description: Judge drift in river mist by how the vapour leans, adjusting the pins before a long shot.

name: Blurring Stakedrive
description: Take a half step to the side so the second aimer has a clear view of the mark.

name: Rumble Stakedrive
description: Snap the stock round on the double pin and loose the moment the two pins touch the mark.

name: Hollowhurtle
description: Choose one officer in the enemy ranks and loose through the single gap that shows him.

name: Mindful Trackbed
description: Sweep qi-sharpened eyes across the whole basin without moving the stock, marking every threat and mark.

name: Facet Boltflight
description: Raise the nose to a high angle and let the bolt fall steeply on a mark that stands behind cover.

name: Blazestake
description: Gather qi in the eyes and arms through a long hold, then loose one bolt along both pins at a distant mark.

name: Mantled Bowarms
description: Drive the iron tail spike into the gravel of a river bar so the carriage stands firm in damp ground.

name: Remnant Sinewcord
description: Plant range posts along the ford's edge so that crews can read distance across running water.

name: Heartening Aimframe
description: Wrap oiled cloth around the skeins to keep river damp out of the sinew.

name: Charter Stockbed
description: Raise a reed screen along the bank so that crews at the engines cannot be counted from across the river.

name: Clawbarrage
description: Loose bolts steadily into the shallows ahead of a fording column, so that men balk and bunch up midstream.

name: Iron Impalement
description: Drive a heavy bolt low into the side of a river barge at the waterline, tearing a plank loose.

name: Skewerbolt Cloak
description: Fire in rhythm along the river line until the ford is shut by falling bolts and no column will enter it.

name: Boltflight Barrage
description: Time each engine of the bend to loose in turn along the current, so the bolts fall in step with the stream.

name: Charter Springarm
description: Spread the feet on the rolling deck and let the knees follow the swell while the hands stay on the stock.

name: Waning Bolthead
description: Test every lashing that holds the engine to the deck, feeling for salt-rotted rope.

name: Vital Windlassdrum
description: Wrap the skeins in tarred cloth so the sea spray never reaches the sinew.

name: Nursing Bowarms
description: Count the rise of the swell by breath, learning the length of one wave before drawing.

name: Equipoise Stockbed
description: Chant the wind-oath to time the winding, each phrase a pull, so that all hands finish together.

name: Nova Stakedrive
description: Release as the deck lifts to the crest, so that the bolt flies level at the target ship's rail.

name: Intentslider
description: Aim along an enemy gunwale and loose so the bolt rakes the rail, driving men from their posts.

name: Lancing Impalement
description: Send a heavy bolt low across an enemy's oar bank, snapping shafts and fouling the rowers.

name: Streakbarrage
description: Drive a heavy bolt into the foot of the enemy mast until the timber cracks.

name: Nova Skewerbolt
description: Hold a bearing on the enemy hull through the heave, gather at full wind, and loose one bolt along that line.

name: Thorn Slider
description: Plant the carriage a stride back from the plateau edge, with the wheels chocked on the bare rock.

name: Verity Aimframe
description: Face the open wind and read its strength from the bend of grass and the tug on the sleeve.

name: Bolthead Elixir
description: Set small cairn stones along the plateau at known distances so the aimer reads range at a glance.

name: Intent Sinewcord
description: Warm the skeins between the palms with qi before the morning's shooting, loosening cold-stiffened sinew.

name: Transfixing Skewerbolt
description: Tilt the stock down the slope and release so the bolt gains speed on a column in the valley.

name: Facet Streak
description: Adjust the stock into a rising gust and release at the lull so the bolt does not drift.

name: Stakeassault
description: Fire at the foot of a climbing rider's path to make the whole line check at the slope.

name: Sliderassault
description: Hold the sight on a single bearing through gusting wind, correcting each breath until the bolt is loosed.

name: Hurtlethrash
description: Gather qi through the long still moment of a sworn aim, then loose one bolt along the held bearing.

name: Unbroken Windlassdrum
description: Set stone chocks behind both wheels at the cliff lip so the engine cannot roll toward the drop.

name: Waning Claw
description: Listen to the wind's rhythm and mark the lull in which a bolt flies true.

name: Might Springarm
description: Drive a short bearing stake beside the stock to mark the line toward a known landmark.

name: Perceptive Trackbed
description: Hang spare bolts from a cord strung along the stock rail so they ride clear of the wind.

name: Clawthrash
description: Loose a bolt down the cliff face at the rock beside climbers, showering them with stone.

name: Streakthrash
description: Skim the bolt just over the cliff lip so it rakes the path below at the height of a man.

name: Sliderbarrage
description: Tilt the stock steeply over the edge and loose a bolt that falls onto a mark far below.

name: Clawassault
description: Hold the bearing on the ledge path and loose steadily, so no man can pass the narrow way.
